title: Day 85: El Sapo Hunt Continues — No Capture; Plan Kukulkan Enters 24-Day Final Phase; Manzanillo Command Void Day 9; CJNG Succession Binary Holds
detail: Day 85 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 85 (NO CAPTURE): Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo' / 'El 090') remains at large as Mexico's Federal Security Cabinet top-priority CJNG enforcement target (named May 3, 2026). No confirmed operation, arrest, or elimination reported through Day 85. CJNG's military chief is maintaining operational continuity across Jalisco, Michoacán, Puebla, and Zacatecas corridors, with his personal security detail — including former Mexican Army, Marines, and Colombian and Guatemalan former combatants — keeping him mobile and concealed. El Sapo controls sicario recruitment and training networks including Rancho Izaguirre in Teuchitlán, Jalisco, and drug trafficking logistics through Zacatecas and Baja California corridors. With El Jardinero arrested April 27, he is the last surviving organized senior military-faction leadership figure. PLAN KUKULKAN — 24 DAYS: Twenty-four days remain before the FIFA World Cup 2026 opening match (June 11, Estadio Azteca, Mexico City). Mexico's 111,000+ security deployment has entered its final operational preparation phase — ~20,000 military, ~12,000 Navy, ~55,000 federal police/SSPC, ~20,000 private security, 2,100 military vehicles, 24 aircraft, 188 K-9 units, drones, and cybersecurity teams coordinating with U.S., Canadian, and FIFA intelligence partners. Guadalajara's Akron Stadium hosts four group-stage matches — in the heart of CJNG's historic operational territory. The continued absence of El Sapo's capture is the primary unresolved security risk for Plan Kukulkan. MANZANILLO COMMAND VOID — DAY 9: Nine days have elapsed since the arrest of Lorenzo Sánchez 'El Chucky' (May 9, 2026), the CJNG plaza boss for the Port of Manzanillo, Mexico's busiest Pacific port. As of Day 9, no publicly identified successor has been named. CJNG's embedded relationships with port customs officials and dock workers remain structurally intact; the port continues operating under heightened Navy-SEMAR surveillance. EL JARDINERO STATUS — EXTRADITION SUSPENDED, MEXICAN PROCEEDINGS ACTIVE: Audias Flores Silva 'El Jardinero' (arrested April 27) remains in Altiplano maximum security prison. His U.S. extradition remains blocked following the May 15 Mexican federal tribunal ratification of the suspension. The DOJ's May 14 superseding indictment (meth trafficking + money laundering + weapons use — minimum 10 years to life) stands active but unenforceable until Mexican proceedings conclude. CIAGATE FGR INVESTIGATION — DAY 85: FGR's criminal investigation of Chihuahua Fiscalía for federal jurisdiction invasion and possible treason ('actos de traición a la patria') continues with no charges announced. The quintuple bilateral pressure track (CIAgate + DOJ Rocha Moya + 'irrefutable proof' extradition standard + State Dept consulate review + ongoing CJNG interdiction) remains at maximum stress. SUCCESSION BINARY — DAY 85: El 03 (Juan Carlos Valencia González, confirmed leader per El País April 6, 2026) vs. El Sapo (military wing, at large). ACLED (May 12): zero evidence of organizational fracture 83 days post-Mencho; CJNG showing 'tactical containment' and reinforcing Michoacán alliances with Los Viagras. DECAPITATION LEDGER — DAY 85: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested March 11), El Jardinero (arrested April 27; DOJ superseding indictment May 14; extradition suspended May 15), El Güero Conta (arrested April 27), El Cabo (arrested May 7; vinculado a proceso May 14), El Chucky/Manzanillo plaza (arrested May 9), El Checo/Tecate regional (arrested May 13). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials detained. 47+ confirmed CJNG HVTs neutralized in post-Mencho campaign.
